name: dumbbell incline one arm lateral raise
description: A one-arm lateral raise on an incline bench. It isolates the side delt, one arm at a time.
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie on your side along it, head toward the top.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand in front of your hips, arm almost straight.
Raise the dumbbell out and up until your arm points at the ceiling.
Pause, then lower it slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then turn over and switch arms.
